question: Which syllable and goddess act as destroyer of time to protect the practitioner?
premises: The goddess Sāvitrī is associated with it
She is described as the destroyer of time
inference: May the syllable ṛ and the goddess Sāvitrī, destroyer of time, protect me.
uncertainties: rddikāraḥ is an unusual form for the syllable ṛ; transcribed as given
plain_english: May the syllable ṛ and the goddess Sāvitrī, the destroyer of time, protect me.
